title: Lesson frontmatter (course format v1)
description: Frontmatter for a lesson page (course/NNN-slug/NN-slug/index.md) or a sub-lesson page (course/NNN-slug/NN-slug/NN-slug/index.md): the page fields, plus a stable id. Renderer-specific keys (layout, hero, ...) are not allowed.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique among the lessons that share the same parent (a lesson within its course, a sub-lesson within its lesson). Never change it after publishing, even if the folder or title changes.
